assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to guide further management of the unspecified cardiac rhythm disturbance
The unspecified cardiac rhythm disturbance is coded I49.9
Mobile cardiac telemetry is indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmias that standard in-office monitoring cannot capture
The service directly supports the patient's symptomatic presentation and diagnostic needs
